reviews.title: It works fine.
reviews.comment: Had no idea that it had rgb, appreciate the antenna cutout, despite wifi not being included. Best Bangalore for buck with a full pcie 5.0 x16 slot and a full working pcie 3.0 x16 slot. This one can run two gpus no problem. The automatic overclocking works really well. You'll never notice it, unless you dig into the bios. Appreciate the ability to disable efficiency cores for 2005 to 2011 games.

reviews.author: Glenn Towle

reviews.title: Good enough, better than expected.
reviews.comment: I was kinda skeptical about this purchase. I usually the person that buys either high end or at the very least top of the line middle of the road when it comes to motherboards. I always thought that a higher phase counts, obviously meant better right? The higher the amp number the better. And yes, that can be true but when running a 14600k I don't need a 350+ motherboard. I'm not overclocking, I play games nothing too demanding, mainly I use it for my 3d printers running different slicing software, programming, setting changes, and flashing firmware for my drones. And this board is perfect so far and I saved 250.00 if I had stuck to how I normally buy motherboards. Didn't have a single problem with the install. Having 3 m.2 slots is nice didn't expect that at this price point. So I'm actually satisfied with purchase. Now, will it last?! No idea we'll see
reviews.author: Jared Irvan

reviews.title: It's a good buy
reviews.comment: I'm one of those people who buys something but doesn't leave a review immediately. I like to test the product over time, and once it's been through some tests, including continuous use, I feel I can give a more accurate opinion. After 18 months, I haven't had any problems with this motherboard. It's aesthetically pleasing; I would have preferred it to be larger, and that's precisely why I'm not giving it 5 stars, since the size wasn't indicated when I bought it. So, the issue is the product description on the platform. It's definitely a good option for its features and price-quality ratio. If you haven't been able to decide yet, go for it; you won't regret it.
